result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers cover the key moves: gray out the other five clinics, make Dunmore stand out, label the lines directly instead of using a legend, write the finding as the title and quiet the gridlines. B gives a little more that can be applied directly, such as drawing Dunmore on top, removing vertical gridlines, a specific y-axis range labeled in minutes, and an accessibility note. A's 'or none at all' gridline option and its default of starting the axis at zero are slightly weaker. Neither gives exact color codes or line widths. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers cover the core fixes well: muting the other five lines, labeling lines directly, writing a title that states the finding, and annotating Dunmore's start and end values. A gives more concrete axis guidance (a 30–75 range with a minutes label, gridlines at 30–70, a wider-than-tall chart) and adds accessibility advice. B's suggestion to start the y-axis at zero and its gridlines at 20/40/60/80 are less suited to a line chart, though B does name example accent colors and adds a helpful subtitle with the unit.
